title: LinkedIn karuseļi par 0 €, ko zīmē kods: bez Canva un dizainera
seoTitle: LinkedIn karuseļi ar Python | Mārketinga Skola
description: Kā viens Python skripts no ieraksta skaitļiem uzzīmē LinkedIn karuseli bez Canva un dizainera: instrukcija AI, pārbaude un PDF, ko pievienot ierakstam.
facts: The source is Rihards Zeila's own English guide (rihardszeila.com/blog/carousel-generator), written from systems he runs himself. Take its content, numbers and steps; write the Latvian fresh, not sentence by sentence.
Never name the print-on-demand store, and never say or hint at what it sells, its theme or its niche: it is only 'a print-on-demand ecommerce project'.
